title: Grateful Dead Live at Paramount Northwest Theatre on 1972-07-22
lineage: Dat (Sony R500) -> VXPocket v2 -> Samplitude Professional v10.1 -> FLAC

ai_review.summary: A lovingly patched soundboard capture of a solid summer‑'72 set with a smoking You Win Again, Bird Song and an epic Morning Dew despite some warbly tape artifacts.
ai_review.review: The recording is a composite of the Bear and Betty front‑of‑house/soundboard tapes, cleaned up but still showing water‑damage wavering and occasional reel wobble. Musically the show is strong – fans point to You Win Again, Bird Song, China Cat Sunflower > I Know You Rider and an unforgettable Morning Dew as highlights, while a few songs suffer from muffed vocals or mix issues.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers rate the show highly (4‑5 stars) and praise its musical moments; recording quality is good overall but notes some technical flaws, yielding a strong combined score.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Front‑of‑house/soundboard tapes patched from Bear and Betty sources; slight warble and water‑damage artifacts, occasional vocal muffs, reel wobble on Sugar Magnolia, but overall clear mix with strong vocal balance.

standout_songs: China Cat Sunflower > I Know You Rider
poor_songs: Beat It On Down the Line (flawed compared to other nights)
show_quality.setlist_flow: The concert feels like two first sets back‑to‑back, with loose transitions and abundant stage banter; the second set builds into tighter jams despite a few mix hiccups.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Leaves his heart onstage, vamping passionately during jams and delivering emotive solos.
band_member_comments.Phil: Strong vocal presence with humorous banter; sounds solid throughout the night.
band_member_comments.Bob: Omnipresent, powerful guitar that drives the show, though occasional muffs are noted.
